review.summary: Two actual guarded M5 transitions correct three no-majority explanations, then store native exact-ID descriptor correspondences for Bacillus subtilis, Levilactobacillus brevis and Lactiplantibacillus plantarum. Reference populations1256/fraction0.91,281/fraction0.97 and2061/fraction1.0 do not identify experimental stock genomes. The corrected notes, four-member roster, A/B/C recipes, yeast exclusion, qualified biology and previous history are preserved.

limitations: Partial diagnostic scientific_review:false. Native validity and reference correspondence do not provide whole-record scientific approval, corpus QC, automatic issue closure or release clearance.

The complete canonical record and retained primary abstract were inspected. Exact experimental strain accessions and stock genomes were not established from that bounded source inspection; absence from the inspected abstract is not a claim of absence from an unread full article or supplement.

Exact-ID reference populations differ from experimental stock identity. Rounded fractions0.91 and0.97 do not specify exact integer numerators or probabilities that the study stocks belong to the reference clusters. No inoculum abundance or strain-genome assignment is inferred.
The crosswalk release remains unestablished; file mtime is not a release date. Full native lineages and source IDs are retained without formally renaming the study stocks.

A/B/C source combinations and equal recipe ratios, all four members, yeast NO_GTDB_EQUIVALENT, measured endpoint qualifications and current graph claims remain unchanged. This scoped diagnostic does not independently establish mechanisms, cross-feeding, clinical or feeding efficacy, or whole-record causal adequacy.

The first transition's eight native checks and55-input checkpoint apply only to the note-only intermediate. Eight required checks below are separate actual commands against final mapping bytes, including a distinct native sidecar.

Local and M5 NCBI database file-stat observations remain separate provenance; no whole-database checksum or build identity is certified. Source/code/crosswalk/application/review inputs are individually hash-bound.

Reference-snippet validation, strict composite historical admission, generated pages and combined full QC remain separate subsequent work. The final review binds both actual transitions for later proof without asserting that integration already passed.

assessments.topic: Experimental species labels remain separate from reference genomes
assessments.summary: The source's four members and A/B/C recipes remain unchanged. Reference mappings do not establish strain accessions, study-stock assemblies, inoculum abundance or formal nomenclatural changes. The lack of exact-stock proof is bounded to inspected evidence.

assessments.summary: The corrected notes state the actual exact-ID populations and rounded fractions without an exact numerator or stock-genome inference. Crosswalk release remains unestablished. Final mapping preserves the three reviewed notes exactly.
